<hr>

I'm a second-year Ph.D. student in Computer Science at North Carolina State University, advised by Dr. Laurie Williams in the Wolfpack Security and Privacy Research (WSPR) Lab.

I started out as a software engineer and now do research, so I bring both professional and academic experience to my work. I like solving problems systematically. My research is in software supply chain security, which looks at how the software we all depend on gets built, shared, and trusted. Currently, my work focuses on software secrets and non-human identities.

I enjoy building software, from web platforms and APIs to developer tooling and my own dotfiles.
